kechua.definition:
n a member of a South American Indian people in Peru who were formerly the ruling class of the Inca empire
n a community of South American Indians in Peru who were formerly the ruling class of the Incan Empire
n the language of the Quechua which was spoken by the Incas

kechuan.definition:
n the language of the Quechua which was spoken by the Incas
a of or relating to the Quechua or their language

keck.definition:
v. i. To heave or to retch, as in an effort to vomit.
n. An effort to vomit; queasiness.
keck.translation: vi. 想吐, 作呕, 极为讨厌

kecked.translation:
vi. 想吐；作呕；极为讨厌
n. (Keck)人名；(英、德)凯克

kecking.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Keck
kecking.translation:
vi. 想吐；作呕；极为讨厌
n. (Keck)人名；(英、德)凯克

keckle.definition:
v. i. & n. See Keck, v. i. & n.
v. t. To wind old rope around, as a cable, to preserve its
   surface from being fretted, or to wind iron chains around, to defend
   from the friction of a rocky bottom, or from the ice.

keckling.definition:
p. pr. & vb. n. of Keckle
n. Old rope or iron chains wound around a cable. See Keckle,
   v. t.
keckling.translation: n. 包缆绳, 防磨卷

kecks.definition:
plural of keck
v. i. To heave or to retch, as in an effort to vomit.
n. An effort to vomit; queasiness.
kecks.translation: (keck 的复数) vi. 想吐, 作呕, 极为讨厌
